findings.evidence: ModularForms/README.md lines 441–472 places degeneracy maps under Layer 3 and says the old/new milestones consume Layers 0 and 2; the ModularForms source tree contains no Hecke-operator or Hecke-algebra implementation.
findings.fix: Defer these lemmas until the prerequisite Layer 2 stage exists on main or in an open PR, or identify a nearer roadmap milestone whose currently implemented work directly consumes them.
findings.issue: Both new level-monotonicity lemmas are justified solely as prerequisites for Layer 3 oldform degeneracy maps, while the roadmap states that the old/new milestones consume Layers 0 and 2 and the checkout has no Layer 2 Hecke-operator implementation.

summary: The lemmas have a genuine path to the Layer 3 degeneracy-map API, but that milestone is premature because its roadmap prerequisites have not landed.
